computer_connect_create_command_intro: Copy the task to your AI assistant on this computer.
computer_connect_create_instructions:
Set up OpenTag in this computer's current environment, for the current operating-system user, and connect it to my Account.

Check the existing installation and connection first. Preserve a working connection; diagnose and restore a broken one. If new authorization is required for an existing Computer, ask me for its targeted recovery task. Run the following only when a new connection is needed:

{command}

Follow the CLI results and guidance. Stop on an identity or Account conflict. Do not overwrite a binding or delete an identity to register again. Do not redeem an already-used authorization. Ask me to refresh an expired authorization when needed; verify an uncertain redemption result before proceeding.

Report the Computer name, Computer ID, and connection result. A running service alone does not prove it is online. Explicitly state if server-side online status could not be confirmed. I will continue setup in the original OpenTag page.
computer_connect_create_preview:
Set up OpenTag on this computer and connect it to my Account.

Check the existing connection first. Preserve it if working; diagnose and restore it if broken. Report the connection result.
